description: Main source code for an I2S audio echo application using Zephyr RTOS, involving button handling, audio stream configuration, and data processing.

methods.name: sw0_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler to toggle echo effect on button press.

methods.name: sw1_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler to toggle I2S streams on button press.

methods.name: init_buttons
methods.description: Initializes GPIO buttons and their interrupts.

methods.name: process_block_data
methods.description: Processes audio data blocks, applying echo effect if enabled.

methods.name: configure_streams
methods.description: Configures I2S RX and TX streams with specified configuration.

methods.name: prepare_transfer
methods.description: Prepares initial data blocks for I2S transfer.

methods.name: trigger_command
methods.description: Triggers start, stop, or drop commands on I2S streams.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing and running the I2S echo loop.
